summary: Iteration 9 e2e testing for the 4 new features: (1) Anexo IV pulsating banner on Dashboard with click-nav to /programacao, (2) Diário de Obra PDF endpoint /api/operacional/daily-log/{project_id}, (3) Web Push (VAPID) endpoints + broadcast, (4) split modules push_notifications.py + daily_log_pdf.py. Backend: 12/12 pytest passed. Frontend: banner + push status UI + project-detail PDF button all working. SW has 'push' and 'notificationclick' listeners. broadcast_push safely handles 0-sub and stale-sub cases (removes 410/invalid). No regressions in /api/alerts/anexo-iv (smoke re-check passed).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1562 lines — consider splitting further (routes for projects/analytics/schedule/operacional) into routers for maintainability. Push and PDF are already extracted, which is a good start.

push_notifications.send_push swallows all WebPush errors and returns False; broadcast_push then deletes the subscription. This is correct for 404/410 (gone) but overly aggressive for transient errors (network/5xx). Consider checking WebPushException.response.status_code and only removing on 404/410.

daily_log_pdf.build_daily_log_pdf embeds photos from data_url without sanitising size — a very large photo could exhaust memory. Reportlab _restrictSize does help but base64 decode happens first. Consider a max-bytes guard.
The endpoint GET /api/operacional/daily-log/{project_id}?notes=... accepts free-form notes via query string; long notes would blow URL length. Consider POST with body for notes.
/api/push/unsubscribe uses body: dict without a Pydantic model — inconsistent with subscribe which uses PushSubscribeBody.
seed_data_creation: Anexo IV projects (project_code starting with TEST-IT9- / TEST-UI-IT9-) created and cleaned up within the same test/browser sessions. Push subscription with a synthetic endpoint was created and then removed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter9 features fully verified. VAPID key persisted in Mongo `settings` (_id='vapid'). broadcast_push logs 'Broadcast push: sent=X removed=Y total=Z' - confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log. PDF endpoint returns 2694 bytes with %PDF magic. Frontend banner uses data-testid='anexo-iv-banner'; push toggle uses push-enable-btn / push-disable-btn / literal text 'Bloqueado no navegador'. Project detail: pd-daily-notes (textarea) + pd-download-daily-log (button, triggers real browser download event, filename pattern 'diario_...pdf'). Note: headless Chromium => Notification.permission='denied', so denied-span is what renders by default.
